title: Capability Replay Output
description: Output of `fwc capability replay <token>`. Reconstructs the predicate-evaluation trace for a single capability token from the audit chain.

token_hash.description: BLAKE3-256 hash of the input token, prefixed with `blake3:`. The raw token MUST NOT appear anywhere in the output; this is the redaction-safe identifier operators see in logs and OTLP spans.

final_verdict.description: Terminal classification of the capability decision.

total_latency_us.description: Wall-clock latency of the replayed predicate evaluation, in microseconds. Reconstructed from audit-chain timestamps, not re-executed.

audit_chain_range.description: Inclusive audit-chain sequence number range that the trace was reconstructed from.

trace.description: Ordered list of predicate evaluation steps.

rule_name.description: Stable predicate rule identifier (e.g. zone_match, capability_token_signature_verify, revocation_check, expiry_check).

inputs_json.description: Input bindings the rule was evaluated against. Secrets MUST be replaced with `{ "<redacted>": { "len": N } }`; raw secret bytes MUST NOT appear here.

output.description: Rule result. `false` for any non-terminal-revocation rejection makes `final_verdict = rejected_predicate`.

witness_chain_indices.description: Audit-chain sequence numbers carrying the evidence this rule consumed. Cross-check with `fwc audit explain --seq <n>` (Phase M.1).

evaluator_version.description: Semver of the predicate evaluator implementation that produced this step at original evaluation time. Replays MUST use the recorded version, not the current one, when reconstructing.
